# Miyorare 1.3.0

## ✨ New

- **Restore destination selection** — Mihon backups can be restored directly to Normal Favourites or Private Favourites instead of mixing collection spaces.
- **Explore extension search** — search the extension list currently shown in Explore without forcing a new network request or extension reload.
- **Editable global search query** — tap the query on global search results, edit it, and run another search directly.
- **Selectable manga description** — Manga Details descriptions support long-press text selection and Copy.
- **Prefilled manga edit form** — Name, Author, and Description are filled from current manga details while existing overrides remain preferred.
- **Explore Suggestions visibility control** — show or hide the Suggestions carousel and keep the choice between sessions.

## 🔧 Improved

- **Safer Normal / Private restore** — restored collection membership is written directly to the selected destination, reducing the risk of Normal and Private state being mixed if restore is interrupted.
- **Category order preservation** — compatible category sort/order is retained more consistently through backup and restore.
- **Private collection separation** — destination-aware handling was tightened across restored collections, Local shelves, and saved-page destinations.
- **Miyorare Source Packs** — updater wiring, compatibility validation, and promotion checks were strengthened for safer pack updates.
- **More compact Explore Suggestions** — suggestion cards use less space while keeping quick access to recommendations.
- **Pinned navigation UI** — pinned bottom navigation stays visible while scrolling; disabling the option keeps the previous hide-on-scroll behavior.

## 🐞 Fixed

- **Large Favourites dialog crash** — category membership is read only for the selected manga on this path instead of scanning every active membership.
- **Restore and compatibility regressions** — release tests were aligned with current behavior and expanded to catch more restore, source, compile, and runtime regressions before stable promotion.
- **General stability** — additional fixes were applied across navigation, collection state, storage handling, and source loading.
